tasks.title: Announcement #13
tasks.instruction: Listen to a librarian talking to a group of students.
tasks.transcript: Attention please. Student cards will be handed to you fully activated, which means you can borrow materials right away. But I'd like you to fill out an application so that your card will not expire after the introductory period. Fill out the easy online application with your barcode ready. You can also use your card online to reserve or renew books.

questions.stem: What is the purpose of the talk?

options.A: To encourage students to borrow books from school library
options.B: To suggest students fill out an application form
options.C: To tell students where to get access to Internet
options.D: To remind students to apply for a new student card

questions.analysis: 题干分析 问题询问这段讲话的目的，属于主旨/目的理解题，需抓住图书管理员整段话的核心意图。 选项分析 选项A：错误。 图书管理员提到学生可以借阅资料，但这是卡片已激活的结果，而非讲话的主要目的。 选项B：正确。 图书管理员明确说“I'd like you to fill out an application”，并说明了填写申请表的原因（防止试用期后卡片失效）和方式（在线填写、备好条形码），整段话的核心目的是建议学生填写申请表。 选项C：错误。 讲话中提到可以在线使用借书证，但并未告诉学生去哪里上网，属于无关信息。 选项D：错误。 学生卡即将发放给学生，无需再申请新卡，讲话目的是让学生填写申请表以延长卡片有效期。

questions.stem: What can be inferred about the student cards?

options.A: It can only be activated after application.
options.B: Students can use it to borrow books now.
options.C: It cannot be activated in the introductory period.
options.D: It will not be expire until students fill out an application.

questions.analysis: 题干分析 问题询问关于学生卡可以推断出什么，属于推理判断题，需抓住讲话中对学生卡状态的描述。 选项分析 选项A：错误。 讲话明确说学生卡发放时已是完全激活状态（fully activated），而非需要申请后才能激活。 选项B：正确。 讲话明确说“Student cards will be handed to you fully activated, which means you can borrow materials right away”，说明学生现在就可以用借书证借书。 选项C：错误。 讲话明确说卡片在试用期内不会失效（so that your card will not expire after the introductory period），但卡片在发放时已经是激活状态，与选项表述不符。 选项D：错误。 讲话说填写申请表是为了让卡片在试用期后不会失效，而非填写申请表之前卡片不会失效，属于逻辑颠倒。
